Found **Alabama HB591 — 2026 Regular Session**.

- **Title:** Rural Health Transformation Program supplemental appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.
- **Recorded status:** Passed; record dated April 13, 2026.
- **Summary:** Provides up to $203,404,327 in federal funds to the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs for rural health initiatives and creates a joint legislative oversight committee.
- **Official text:** [Enrolled HB591 PDF, dated April 9, 2026](https://alison.legislature.state.al.us/files/pdf/SearchableInstruments/2026RS/HB591-enr.pdf).

Source: Cicada Guide’s exact bill search and latest-document tools. The recorded status and enrolled document do not by themselves establish governor approval or enactment.

governor_action.summary: In Alabama, the governor has 6 days to act on a bill during session, after which the bill becomes law without a signature. If the legislature has adjourned, the governor has 10 days, after which the bill is pocket vetoed. The bill text sets when it takes effect.
governor_action.note: A general rule: when each deadline starts (presentment, delivery or adjournment), excluded weekends and holidays, emergency clauses and dates in the bill text can change it.
